limits: Voxel-cell boundaries preserve computational occupancy, not true subvoxel nerve boundaries.
Edge or corner contacts in source labels can produce non-manifold boundary geometry; these are retained and reported.
Comparison with the 0.5 isosurface measures representation sensitivity, not anatomical error.
Lighting normal fallback at singular vertices has no effect on positions or topology.
